name: Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver
oracle_text:
+2: Exile the top three cards of target opponent's library.
−X: Put a creature card with mana value X exiled with Ashiok onto the battlefield under your control. That creature is a Nightmare in addition to its other types.
−10: Exile all cards from all opponents' hands and graveyards.
blocked_sentences: −X: Put a creature card with mana value X exiled with Ashiok onto the battlefield under your control. That creature is a Nightmare in addition to its other types.

needs.what: a variable loyalty cost "−X" (606.4 / 107.3): the controller announces X on activation, removes X loyalty counters from the planeswalker as the cost (payable only if it has at least X), and the ability's effects read that X via the `x` value -- here as `mana_value: {"x": ...}` on a `put_onto_battlefield` over `{"zone": "exile", "exiled_with": "self", "types": ["Creature"]}` followed by `add_subtype` Nightmare on the moved card. The +2 must also exile with a link (`exile` op's `link`) so `exiled_with: self` finds those cards.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Cost.loyalty is a signed int only (schema.py) -- there is no way to write X; `x_value` fills an {X} in a mana cost, not a loyalty cost; `remove_counters` as a cost would drop the loyalty-ability status (606.3 once-per-turn, sorcery timing and interaction with loyalty-ability statics are keyed on cost.loyalty being set) and has no announced-X amount.
